questions.q: Adolescents often experience 'mood swings', transitioning rapidly between happiness and sadness. This is primarily considered a/an:
options: Emotional or psychological change driven by hormones
Physical change causing bones to lengthen
questions.explain: Mood swings are very common during adolescence; they are emotional and psychological responses largely triggered by the sudden surge of hormones (like estrogen and testosterone) during puberty.

questions.q: Forcing an adolescent out of school into early marriage or hazardous manual labor is a severe violation of their right to:
options: Basic education and protection from exploitation
questions.explain: The rights of the child categorically state that every child has the right to free basic education and must be protected from economic exploitation and harmful traditional practices.

questions.q: What is meant by 'vertical transmission' in the context of HIV/AIDS?
options: Transmission of the virus from a tall person to a short person.
Transmission of the virus through a vertical needle during a tattoo session.
Transmission of the virus from an infected mother to her child during pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding.
Transmission through breathing the same air in a crowded room.
questions.explain: Vertical transmission (or Mother-To-Child Transmission, MTCT) refers specifically to the virus being passed from an HIV-positive mother to her infant during pregnancy, labor, delivery, or breastfeeding.
